counter_and_identity_checks.source_toolchain_binary_end_check: passed in measured runner before summary error; independently rechecked offline.
counter_and_identity_checks.zeroing_contract: Every arm returns fully zeroed payloads before field stores; only the tree root-push pairing differs between the two custom arms. Allocation path and store sequence are unchanged.

counter_normalization: Raw measured JSONL unchanged. Equality ignores the above row metadata and timing/RSS/phase duration fields only; every remaining deterministic custom counter is compared exactly.
decision: Screening only. Root-pair improves the offset tree median but does not beat baseline at the aligned capacity; it does not pass the predeclared two-capacity advance gate.

environment_policy.boehm_default: remove all GC_* then set GC_FREE_SPACE_DIVISOR=1; leave GC_INITIAL_HEAP_SIZE unset
environment_policy.boehm_fixed128: remove all GC_* then set GC_FREE_SPACE_DIVISOR=1 and GC_INITIAL_HEAP_SIZE=134217728

limits: Six samples per arm and cell; this is a screening matrix, not confirmation.
128 MiB denotes initial heap size; the heap is allowed to grow.
The per-round ratios and min/median/max are descriptive; no broad collector winner claim is inferred.
Controls show mixed effects; no >5% benefit claim is made from unchanged-noise controls.
Root-pair work is applied only to tree construction in custom candidate; Boehm comparators use baseline workload/source and their pair API is a no-op control.

matrix_policy.advance_gate: Candidate must beat custom baseline on tree at both nursery capacities with exact equality of deterministic custom counters; control differences are screening observations and not claimed as >5% improvements.
matrix_policy.execution: Six cyclic rounds per cell, rotate by round modulo six; every arm appears in every position once. Cells run serially; new process per row.

heap_policy.both_boehm_cohorts: GC_FREE_SPACE_DIVISOR=1; fresh process; 128 MiB is initial size, not maximum.

matrix_policy.selection: Numeric fastest Boehm is minimum median among four B arms; retain default/fixed cohort best separately.
matrix_policy.zeroing_contract: Every arm returns fully zeroed payloads before field stores; only the tree root-push pairing differs between the two custom arms. Allocation path and store sequence are unchanged.

measurement_failure_provenance.cause: zeroing_contract is nested at matrix_policy.zeroing_contract; all 288 workload subprocesses and end-of-run frozen-input revalidation completed first.
measurement_failure_provenance.impact: No row lost or modified; offline reducer generated all comparisons. No timing reruns were performed.

posthoc_metadata_corrections.correction: All measured workloads are pointer-bearing, so the zeroing contract is matched for these rows. The previous broad description incorrectly said historical Boehm explicitly memset atomic payloads. The frozen baseline generic allocate path uses GC_malloc_atomic without memset; atomic payload behavior was not measured.

import sys
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess

repo = Path('/root/.codex/worktrees/f396/medaka')
scratch = Path('/tmp/medaka-root-pair-85')
previous = Path('/tmp/medaka-retained-tree-profile-85c364304')
phase_base = (previous / 'test/gc_prototype/workload-phase.c').read_text()
base_work = (scratch / 'baseline/workload.c').read_text()
candidate_work = (scratch / 'candidate/workload.c').read_text()
begin, end = 'static Word tree(', 'static uint64_t sum_tree('
old_tree = base_work[base_work.index(begin):base_work.index(end)]
new_tree = candidate_work[candidate_work.index(begin):candidate_work.index(end)]
assert phase_base.count(old_tree) == 1
phase_candidate = phase_base.replace(old_tree, new_tree)
sources = {}
for name, phase in (('baseline', phase_base), ('candidate', phase_candidate)):
    source = scratch / (name + '-phase-source')
    source.mkdir()
    for file in ('gc.c', 'gc.h'):
        shutil.copyfile(scratch / name / file, source / file)
    (source / 'workload.c').write_text(phase)
    sources[name] = source
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('gc_run', repo / 'test/gc_prototype/run.py')
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
mod.REPO = repo
build = scratch / 'build'
build.mkdir()
mod.adapter(build)
custom = ('USE_PREPARED', 'INLINE_ALLOC', 'INLINE_STORE')
caller = ('USE_BOEHM', 'USE_CALLER_INLINE', 'USE_PREPARED', 'INLINE_ALLOC', 'INLINE_STORE')
arms = {
    'custom_baseline': ('baseline', custom, False),
    'custom_root_pair': ('candidate', custom + ('ROOT_PAIR',), False),
    'boehm_inline': ('baseline', ('USE_BOEHM', 'USE_INLINE'), True),
    'boehm_caller_inline': ('baseline', caller, True),
    'boehm_caller_root_pair_control': ('candidate', caller + ('ROOT_PAIR',), True),
}
env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('GC_')}
env['GC_FREE_SPACE_DIVISOR'] = '1'
manifest = {'baseline_commit': '85c364304684c44c544957c8ba2b180d15d736c5',
            'source_hashes': {name: {f: hashlib.sha256((p / f).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                                   for f in ('gc.c', 'gc.h', 'workload.c')} for name, p in sources.items()},
            'phase_sources': {k: str(p) for k, p in sources.items()},
            'boehm': mod.boehm_config(), 'arms': {},
            'clock_policy': 'Same prior three tree-boundary clocks, only tree root call sites differ.',
            'compile_policy': 'clang -std=c11 -O2 -g -Wall -Wextra -Werror; separate TUs, no LTO; all checks on.',
            'zeroing_policy': 'No allocation or initialization change; all baseline APIs and zeroing remain.',
            'counter_delta': 'Zero for all deterministic custom counters; root ledger and peaks exact.',
            'environment': {'GC_FREE_SPACE_DIVISOR': '1', 'other_GC_vars': 'cleared'}}
reference = {}
for name, (source_name, defines, boehm) in arms.items():
    mod.HERE = sources[source_name]
    binary = mod.build(build, name, defines, boehm=boehm)
    result = subprocess.run([str(binary), '--selftest'], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
    assert result.stdout == 'selftest passed\n' and not result.stderr
    rows = []
    for capacity in (240, 262136, 262144):
        for profile in mod.PROFILES:
            result = subprocess.run([str(binary), profile, '4096', str(capacity)], check=True,
                                    capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
            assert not result.stderr
            row = json.loads(result.stdout)
            assert row['checksum'] == 4096 * 4095 // 2
            assert row['allocations'] == 4096 + (profile == 'mutation')
            key = (capacity, profile)
            if name.startswith('custom'):
                counters = {k: v for k, v in row.items() if 'seconds' not in k and 'rss' not in k}
                if name == 'custom_baseline': reference[key] = counters
                else: assert counters == reference[key], (key, counters, reference[key])
            rows.append(row)
    assembly = build / (name + '.s')
    assembly.write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['objdump', '-d', str(binary)]))
    manifest['arms'][name] = {'binary': str(binary), 'binary_sha256': hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                              'source': source_name, 'defines': defines, 'command': mod.BUILD_COMMANDS[name],
                              'selftest': 'passed', 'smoke_rows': rows, 'assembly': str(assembly)}
manifest['adapter_paths'] = {str(p): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                            for p in (build / 'boehm_adapter.c', build / 'boehm_caller.h')}
manifest['build_helper_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
(scratch / 'build-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'arms': {k: {'selftest': v['selftest'], 'smoke_rows': len(v['smoke_rows']),
                              'binary_sha256': v['binary_sha256']} for k, v in manifest['arms'].items()},
                  'source_hashes': manifest['source_hashes']}))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Frozen screening runner; it builds nothing and times only manifest-pinned binaries."""
from __future__ import annotations
import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,platform,statistics,subprocess,time

ROOT=pathlib.Path('/tmp/pool-verify-root-pair')
MANIFEST=ROOT/'build-manifest.json'
RESULTS=ROOT/'results.jsonl'
SUMMARY=ROOT/'summary.json'
PROFILES=('tree','list','ephemeral','mutation')
CAPACITIES=(262136,262144)
COUNT=5_000_000
ROUNDS=6
ARM_ORDER=('custom_baseline','custom_root_pair','boehm_inline_default','boehm_inline_fixed128',
           'boehm_caller_default','boehm_caller_fixed128')
ROW_DYNAMIC={'elapsed_seconds','process_peak_rss_bytes','preparation_seconds',
 'tree_construction_including_root_setup_seconds','tree_checksum_traversal_seconds',
 'tree_final_major_plus_workload_cleanup_seconds','driver_wall_nanoseconds',
 'arm','round','execution_position','nursery_bytes','heap_cohort'}
def sha(path): return hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def validate_manifest(m):
    assert m['baseline_commit']=='85c364304684c44c544957c8ba2b180d15d736c5'
    assert m['status']=='candidate_ready_waiting_timing_release'
    assert m['timing_release'] is True
    assert set(m['arms'])==set(ARM_ORDER)
    assert m['matrix_policy']['count']==COUNT
    assert m['matrix_policy']['profiles']==list(PROFILES)
    assert m['matrix_policy']['nursery_capacities']==list(CAPACITIES)
    assert m['matrix_policy']['rounds']==ROUNDS
    assert m['validation']['correctness']=='passed' and m['validation']['independent_fixture']=='passed'
    for item in m['frozen_sources']+m['toolchain']['transitive_boehm_headers']:
        assert sha(item['path'])==item['sha256'],item['path']
    assert sha(m['boehm']['archive_path'])==m['boehm']['archive_sha256']
    for arm in ARM_ORDER:
        info=m['arms'][arm]
        assert sha(info['binary'])==info['binary_sha256'],arm
        assert info['zeroed_payload_contract']
def env_for(arm,base):
    env=base.copy()
    for key in list(env):
        if key.startswith('GC_'): env.pop(key)
    if arm.startswith('boehm_'):
        env['GC_FREE_SPACE_DIVISOR']='1'
        if arm.endswith('_fixed128'): env['GC_INITIAL_HEAP_SIZE']='134217728'
    return env
def stable(row): return {k:v for k,v in row.items() if k not in ROW_DYNAMIC}
def launch(binary,arm,profile,cap,info):
    cmd=[str(binary),profile,str(COUNT),str(cap)]
    before=time.perf_counter_ns()
    cp=subprocess.run(cmd,env=env_for(arm,os.environ.copy()),capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=180)
    duration=time.perf_counter_ns()-before
    if cp.returncode or cp.stderr: raise RuntimeError(f'{arm}/{profile}/{cap}: rc={cp.returncode}, stderr={cp.stderr!r}')
    lines=cp.stdout.splitlines()
    if len(lines)!=1: raise RuntimeError(f'{arm}: expected one JSON stdout row, got {len(lines)}')
    row=json.loads(lines[0])
    assert row['profile']==profile and row['count']==COUNT
    assert row['allocations']==COUNT+(profile=='mutation')
    assert row['checksum']==COUNT*(COUNT-1)//2
    assert row['payload_bytes']>0
    assert row['tree_phase_available']==(profile=='tree')
    if profile=='tree':
        for key in ('tree_construction_including_root_setup_seconds','tree_checksum_traversal_seconds','tree_final_major_plus_workload_cleanup_seconds'):
            assert row[key]>=0
    row.update({'arm':arm,'heap_cohort':info['heap_cohort'],'round':None,
                'execution_position':None,'nursery_bytes':cap,'driver_wall_nanoseconds':duration})
    return row

def main():
    if RESULTS.exists() or SUMMARY.exists(): raise SystemExit('refusing to overwrite prior scratch results')
    m=json.loads(MANIFEST.read_text())
    validate_manifest(m)
    records=[]; order_rows=[]
    for profile in PROFILES:
      for cap in CAPACITIES:
       for rnd in range(ROUNDS):
        off=rnd%len(ARM_ORDER); order=ARM_ORDER[off:]+ARM_ORDER[:off]
        order_rows.append({'profile':profile,'nursery_bytes':cap,'round':rnd,'arm_order':list(order)})
        group=[]
        for pos,arm in enumerate(order):
            info=m['arms'][arm]
            row=launch(pathlib.Path(info['binary']),arm,profile,cap,info)
            row['round']=rnd; row['execution_position']=pos
            group.append(row); records.append(row)
            with RESULTS.open('a') as f: f.write(json.dumps(row,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))+'\n')
        identities={(r['allocations'],r['payload_bytes'],r['checksum']) for r in group}
        if len(identities)!=1: raise RuntimeError(f'identity mismatch {profile}/{cap}/{rnd}: {identities}')
        custom={r['arm']:r for r in group if r['arm'].startswith('custom_')}
        assert (stable(custom['custom_baseline'])==stable(custom['custom_root_pair'])), \
            'root-pair changed deterministic custom counters'
    # Numeric fastest Boehm by median among all four arms; retain per-cohort best.
    cells=[]
    B=('boehm_inline_default','boehm_inline_fixed128','boehm_caller_default','boehm_caller_fixed128')
    for profile in PROFILES:
      for cap in CAPACITIES:
        cell=[r for r in records if r['profile']==profile and r['nursery_bytes']==cap]
        by={arm:[r for r in cell if r['arm']==arm] for arm in ARM_ORDER}
        med={arm:statistics.median(r['elapsed_seconds'] for r in rs) for arm,rs in by.items()}
        best=min(B,key=lambda arm:med[arm])
        cohort_best={cohort:min((a for a in B if a.endswith('_'+cohort)),key=lambda a:med[a]) for cohort in ('default','fixed128')}
        phase={}
        if profile=='tree':
            for field in ('tree_construction_including_root_setup_seconds','tree_checksum_traversal_seconds','tree_final_major_plus_workload_cleanup_seconds'):
                phase[field]={a:statistics.median(r[field] for r in rs) for a,rs in by.items()}
        cells.append({'profile':profile,'nursery_bytes':cap,'repeats_per_arm':ROUNDS,
          'arms':{a:{'min_seconds':min(r['elapsed_seconds'] for r in by[a]),'median_seconds':med[a],
                     'max_seconds':max(r['elapsed_seconds'] for r in by[a]),
                     'min_rss_bytes':min(r['process_peak_rss_bytes'] for r in by[a]),
                     'median_rss_bytes':statistics.median(r['process_peak_rss_bytes'] for r in by[a]),
                     'max_rss_bytes':max(r['process_peak_rss_bytes'] for r in by[a])} for a in ARM_ORDER},
          'fastest_boehm_arm':best,'fastest_boehm_per_heap_cohort':cohort_best,
          'custom_baseline_over_best_boehm':med['custom_baseline']/med[best],
          'custom_root_pair_over_best_boehm':med['custom_root_pair']/med[best],
          'phase_medians':phase})
    # Ensure every executable and all frozen source/toolchain inputs remained identical.
    validate_manifest(m)
    summary={'schema':'root-pair-screening-matrix.v1','manifest_sha256':sha(MANIFEST),
      'source_commit':m['baseline_commit'],'count':COUNT,'profiles':list(PROFILES),
      'capacities':list(CAPACITIES),'rounds':ROUNDS,'rows':len(records),'cells':cells,
      'execution_order':order_rows,'timing_boundary':'Fresh process includes startup, measured workload, checksum, final major and workload root cleanup; descriptor preparation occurs before workload timing. Tree phases include build with root registration, checksum traversal, and final major plus cleanup.',
      'environment_policy':m['environment_policy'],'zeroing_contract':m['zeroing_contract'],
      'best_b_selection':'Numeric minimum median among historical/default, historical/fixed128, caller-inline/default, caller-inline/fixed128; per-cohort best also recorded.',
      'paired_checks':'All arms match allocation count/payload/checksum per cell-round; custom baseline and root-pair have exact stable deterministic Stats equality. Timing/RSS/phase and runner metadata excluded from counter comparison.',
      'balanced_positions':'Each six-round cell rotates six arms; each arm occupies every position exactly once.',
      'runner_path':str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve()),'runner_sha256':sha(__file__),
      'platform':platform.platform(),'machine':platform.machine(),'build_manifest':m}
    SUMMARY.write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps({'rows':len(records),'summary':str(SUMMARY),'summary_sha256':sha(SUMMARY)},indent=2))
if __name__=='__main__': main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Offline reducer for the frozen root-pair screen; never invokes workload binaries."""
import hashlib,json,pathlib,statistics
from collections import defaultdict
ROOT=pathlib.Path('/tmp/pool-verify-root-pair')
RAW=ROOT/'results.jsonl'; MAN=ROOT/'build-manifest.json'; RUNNER=ROOT/'run_matrix.py'; OUT=ROOT/'summary.json'
PROFILES=('tree','list','ephemeral','mutation'); CAPS=(262136,262144); ROUNDS=6
ARMS=('custom_baseline','custom_root_pair','boehm_inline_default','boehm_inline_fixed128','boehm_caller_default','boehm_caller_fixed128')
B=ARMS[2:]
DYNAMIC={'elapsed_seconds','process_peak_rss_bytes','preparation_seconds','tree_construction_including_root_setup_seconds',
 'tree_checksum_traversal_seconds','tree_final_major_plus_workload_cleanup_seconds','driver_wall_nanoseconds',
 'arm','round','execution_position','nursery_bytes','heap_cohort'}
def sha(p): return hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def stable(r): return {k:v for k,v in r.items() if k not in DYNAMIC}
def median(v): return statistics.median(v)
def stats(rows,key):
 values=[r[key] for r in rows]
 return {'min':min(values),'median':median(values),'max':max(values)}
def main():
 assert not OUT.exists(),'refusing to overwrite prior summary'
 manifest=json.loads(MAN.read_text()); rows=[json.loads(x) for x in RAW.read_text().splitlines()]
 assert len(rows)==288
 assert manifest['status']=='candidate_ready_waiting_timing_release' and manifest['timing_release'] is True
 assert sha(RUNNER)==manifest['frozen_sources'][next(i for i,x in enumerate(manifest['frozen_sources']) if x['path']==str(RUNNER))]['sha256']
 assert sha(RAW)==hashlib.sha256(RAW.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 assert sha(MAN)==hashlib.sha256(MAN.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 # Independently verify source/toolchain and executable hashes after measurements.
 for x in manifest['frozen_sources']+manifest['toolchain']['transitive_boehm_headers']:
  assert sha(x['path'])==x['sha256'],x['path']
 for arm,x in manifest['arms'].items(): assert sha(x['binary'])==x['binary_sha256'],arm
 # Check all row keys, identities, balanced positions, and exact custom deterministic equality.
 assert {r['arm'] for r in rows}==set(ARMS)
 assert {(r['profile'],r['nursery_bytes']) for r in rows}=={(p,c) for p in PROFILES for c in CAPS}
 grouped=defaultdict(list)
 for r in rows:
  assert r['count']==5_000_000 and r['checksum']==5_000_000*4_999_999//2
  assert r['allocations']==5_000_000+(r['profile']=='mutation')
  assert r['heap_cohort']==manifest['arms'][r['arm']]['heap_cohort']
  grouped[(r['profile'],r['nursery_bytes'],r['round'])].append(r)
 custom_checks=[]; order=[]
 for profile in PROFILES:
  for cap in CAPS:
   positions=defaultdict(list)
   for rnd in range(ROUNDS):
    g=grouped[(profile,cap,rnd)]; assert len(g)==6
    assert {r['arm'] for r in g}==set(ARMS)
    assert len({(r['allocations'],r['payload_bytes'],r['checksum']) for r in g})==1
    by={r['arm']:r for r in g}
    assert stable(by['custom_baseline'])==stable(by['custom_root_pair'])
    custom_checks.append({'profile':profile,'nursery_bytes':cap,'round':rnd,'passed':True,
       'identity':[by['custom_baseline']['allocations'],by['custom_baseline']['payload_bytes'],by['custom_baseline']['checksum']],
       'custom_baseline_vs_root_pair_deterministic_stats':'exact'})
    for r in g: positions[r['arm']].append(r['execution_position'])
    order.append({'profile':profile,'nursery_bytes':cap,'round':rnd,
      'arms_by_position':[r['arm'] for r in sorted(g,key=lambda r:r['execution_position'])]})
   assert all(sorted(v)==list(range(6)) for v in positions.values())
 cells=[]
 for profile in PROFILES:
  for cap in CAPS:
   cell=[r for r in rows if r['profile']==profile and r['nursery_bytes']==cap]
   by={a:[r for r in cell if r['arm']==a] for a in ARMS}
   med={a:median([r['elapsed_seconds'] for r in rr]) for a,rr in by.items()}
   best=min(B,key=lambda a:med[a])
   cohort_best={cohort:min([a for a in B if a.endswith('_'+cohort)],key=lambda a:med[a]) for cohort in ('default','fixed128')}
   phases={}
   if profile=='tree':
    for field in ('tree_construction_including_root_setup_seconds','tree_checksum_traversal_seconds','tree_final_major_plus_workload_cleanup_seconds'):
     phases[field]={a:stats(by[a],field) for a in ARMS}
   paired=[]
   for rnd in range(ROUNDS):
    grp={r['arm']:r for r in grouped[(profile,cap,rnd)]}
    paired.append({'round':rnd,'root_pair_over_custom_baseline':grp['custom_root_pair']['elapsed_seconds']/grp['custom_baseline']['elapsed_seconds'],
      'custom_baseline_over_fastest_boehm_arm':grp['custom_baseline']['elapsed_seconds']/grp[best]['elapsed_seconds'],
      'custom_root_pair_over_fastest_boehm_arm':grp['custom_root_pair']['elapsed_seconds']/grp[best]['elapsed_seconds']})
   cells.append({'profile':profile,'nursery_bytes':cap,'samples_per_arm':ROUNDS,
    'arms':{a:{**stats(by[a],'elapsed_seconds'),'process_peak_rss_bytes':stats(by[a],'process_peak_rss_bytes')} for a in ARMS},
    'fastest_boehm_arm_all_four':best,'fastest_boehm_arm_by_cohort':cohort_best,
    'median_ratio_baseline_custom_over_fastest_boehm':med['custom_baseline']/med[best],
    'median_ratio_root_pair_custom_over_fastest_boehm':med['custom_root_pair']/med[best],
    'median_root_pair_over_baseline':med['custom_root_pair']/med['custom_baseline'],
    'paired_round_ratios':paired,'tree_phase_stats':phases})
 audit={'schema':'root-pair-screening-audit.v1','source_commit':manifest['baseline_commit'],
  'result':'screening only; no broad collector winner claim. Advance root-pair only if it beats baseline on tree at both capacities and deterministic custom counters remain exact.',
  'raw_results_path':str(RAW),'raw_results_sha256':sha(RAW),'raw_row_count':len(rows),
  'measured_runner':{'path':str(RUNNER),'sha256':sha(RUNNER),'full_text':RUNNER.read_text(),
    'posthoc_failure':'After all 288 workload processes and final frozen-input revalidation succeeded, runner exited 1 while constructing summary due to a missing top-level zeroing_contract key; the value is stored under matrix_policy. No timing rows were lost or rerun; this summary was reduced offline.'},
  'offline_reducer':{'path':str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve()),'sha256':sha(__file__),'full_text':pathlib.Path(__file__).read_text()},
  'manifest_path':str(MAN),'manifest_sha256':sha(MAN),'manifest_full_text':MAN.read_text(),
  'validation':{'rows':len(rows),'identity_checks':len(grouped),'custom_counter_pairs':len(custom_checks),
    'custom_counters_exact':all(x['passed'] for x in custom_checks),'zeroing_contract':manifest['matrix_policy']['zeroing_contract'],
    'balanced_positions_per_cell':True,'source_toolchain_binary_end_check':'passed in measured runner before summary error; independently rechecked offline.'},
  'policy':manifest['matrix_policy'],'environment_policy':manifest['environment_policy'],
  'toolchain':manifest['toolchain'],'boehm':manifest['boehm'],'arms':manifest['arms'],
  'matrix':cells,'execution_order':order,'custom_counter_checks':custom_checks,
  'measurement_notes':['Fresh process per row; total elapsed includes launch, workload construction/checksum/final collection and root cleanup, with descriptor setup outside the workload timer.','128 MiB is Boehm initial heap size; heap may grow. Default leaves GC_INITIAL_HEAP_SIZE unset.','Best Boehm is numeric median minimum across historical/default, historical/fixed128, caller-inline/default, caller-inline/fixed128; cohort-specific minima also retained.','No >5% benefit claim is made from unchanged controls; six samples per arm are a screening sample.'],
  'posthoc_row_metadata':['arm','round','execution_position','nursery_bytes','heap_cohort','driver_wall_nanoseconds'],'counter_normalization':'Raw measured JSONL unchanged. Equality ignores the above row metadata and timing/RSS/phase duration fields only; every remaining deterministic custom counter is compared exactly.',
  'platform':manifest['toolchain']['platform'],'machine':manifest['toolchain']['machine']}
 OUT.write_text(json.dumps(audit,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
 print(json.dumps({'rows':len(rows),'cells':len(cells),'custom_groups_exact':len(custom_checks),'summary':str(OUT),'summary_sha256':sha(OUT),'best_b':[{k:c[k] for k in ('profile','nursery_bytes','fastest_boehm_arm_all_four')} for c in cells]},indent=2))
if __name__=='__main__': main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Frozen screening runner; it builds nothing and times only manifest-pinned binaries."""
from __future__ import annotations
import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,platform,statistics,subprocess,time

ROOT=pathlib.Path('/tmp/pool-verify-root-pair')
MANIFEST=ROOT/'build-manifest.json'
RESULTS=ROOT/'results.jsonl'
SUMMARY=ROOT/'summary.json'
PROFILES=('tree','list','ephemeral','mutation')
CAPACITIES=(262136,262144)
COUNT=5_000_000
ROUNDS=6
ARM_ORDER=('custom_baseline','custom_root_pair','boehm_inline_default','boehm_inline_fixed128',
           'boehm_caller_default','boehm_caller_fixed128')
ROW_DYNAMIC={'elapsed_seconds','process_peak_rss_bytes','preparation_seconds',
 'tree_construction_including_root_setup_seconds','tree_checksum_traversal_seconds',
 'tree_final_major_plus_workload_cleanup_seconds','driver_wall_nanoseconds',
 'arm','round','execution_position','nursery_bytes','heap_cohort'}
def sha(path): return hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def validate_manifest(m):
    assert m['baseline_commit']=='85c364304684c44c544957c8ba2b180d15d736c5'
    assert m['status']=='candidate_ready_waiting_timing_release'
    assert m['timing_release'] is True
    assert set(m['arms'])==set(ARM_ORDER)
    assert m['matrix_policy']['count']==COUNT
    assert m['matrix_policy']['profiles']==list(PROFILES)
    assert m['matrix_policy']['nursery_capacities']==list(CAPACITIES)
    assert m['matrix_policy']['rounds']==ROUNDS
    assert m['validation']['correctness']=='passed' and m['validation']['independent_fixture']=='passed'
    for item in m['frozen_sources']+m['toolchain']['transitive_boehm_headers']:
        assert sha(item['path'])==item['sha256'],item['path']
    assert sha(m['boehm']['archive_path'])==m['boehm']['archive_sha256']
    for arm in ARM_ORDER:
        info=m['arms'][arm]
        assert sha(info['binary'])==info['binary_sha256'],arm
        assert info['zeroed_payload_contract']
def env_for(arm,base):
    env=base.copy()
    for key in list(env):
        if key.startswith('GC_'): env.pop(key)
    if arm.startswith('boehm_'):
        env['GC_FREE_SPACE_DIVISOR']='1'
        if arm.endswith('_fixed128'): env['GC_INITIAL_HEAP_SIZE']='134217728'
    return env
def stable(row): return {k:v for k,v in row.items() if k not in ROW_DYNAMIC}
def launch(binary,arm,profile,cap,info):
    cmd=[str(binary),profile,str(COUNT),str(cap)]
    before=time.perf_counter_ns()
    cp=subprocess.run(cmd,env=env_for(arm,os.environ.copy()),capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=180)
    duration=time.perf_counter_ns()-before
    if cp.returncode or cp.stderr: raise RuntimeError(f'{arm}/{profile}/{cap}: rc={cp.returncode}, stderr={cp.stderr!r}')
    lines=cp.stdout.splitlines()
    if len(lines)!=1: raise RuntimeError(f'{arm}: expected one JSON stdout row, got {len(lines)}')
    row=json.loads(lines[0])
    assert row['profile']==profile and row['count']==COUNT
    assert row['allocations']==COUNT+(profile=='mutation')
    assert row['checksum']==COUNT*(COUNT-1)//2
    assert row['payload_bytes']>0
    assert row['tree_phase_available']==(profile=='tree')
    if profile=='tree':
        for key in ('tree_construction_including_root_setup_seconds','tree_checksum_traversal_seconds','tree_final_major_plus_workload_cleanup_seconds'):
            assert row[key]>=0
    row.update({'arm':arm,'heap_cohort':info['heap_cohort'],'round':None,
                'execution_position':None,'nursery_bytes':cap,'driver_wall_nanoseconds':duration})
    return row

def main():
    if RESULTS.exists() or SUMMARY.exists(): raise SystemExit('refusing to overwrite prior scratch results')
    m=json.loads(MANIFEST.read_text())
    validate_manifest(m)
    records=[]; order_rows=[]
    for profile in PROFILES:
      for cap in CAPACITIES:
       for rnd in range(ROUNDS):
        off=rnd%len(ARM_ORDER); order=ARM_ORDER[off:]+ARM_ORDER[:off]
        order_rows.append({'profile':profile,'nursery_bytes':cap,'round':rnd,'arm_order':list(order)})
        group=[]
        for pos,arm in enumerate(order):
            info=m['arms'][arm]
            row=launch(pathlib.Path(info['binary']),arm,profile,cap,info)
            row['round']=rnd; row['execution_position']=pos
            group.append(row); records.append(row)
            with RESULTS.open('a') as f: f.write(json.dumps(row,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))+'\n')
        identities={(r['allocations'],r['payload_bytes'],r['checksum']) for r in group}
        if len(identities)!=1: raise RuntimeError(f'identity mismatch {profile}/{cap}/{rnd}: {identities}')
        custom={r['arm']:r for r in group if r['arm'].startswith('custom_')}
        assert (stable(custom['custom_baseline'])==stable(custom['custom_root_pair'])), \
            'root-pair changed deterministic custom counters'
    # Numeric fastest Boehm by median among all four arms; retain per-cohort best.
    cells=[]
    B=('boehm_inline_default','boehm_inline_fixed128','boehm_caller_default','boehm_caller_fixed128')
    for profile in PROFILES:
      for cap in CAPACITIES:
        cell=[r for r in records if r['profile']==profile and r['nursery_bytes']==cap]
        by={arm:[r for r in cell if r['arm']==arm] for arm in ARM_ORDER}
        med={arm:statistics.median(r['elapsed_seconds'] for r in rs) for arm,rs in by.items()}
        best=min(B,key=lambda arm:med[arm])
        cohort_best={cohort:min((a for a in B if a.endswith('_'+cohort)),key=lambda a:med[a]) for cohort in ('default','fixed128')}
        phase={}
        if profile=='tree':
            for field in ('tree_construction_including_root_setup_seconds','tree_checksum_traversal_seconds','tree_final_major_plus_workload_cleanup_seconds'):
                phase[field]={a:statistics.median(r[field] for r in rs) for a,rs in by.items()}
        cells.append({'profile':profile,'nursery_bytes':cap,'repeats_per_arm':ROUNDS,
          'arms':{a:{'min_seconds':min(r['elapsed_seconds'] for r in by[a]),'median_seconds':med[a],
                     'max_seconds':max(r['elapsed_seconds'] for r in by[a]),
                     'min_rss_bytes':min(r['process_peak_rss_bytes'] for r in by[a]),
                     'median_rss_bytes':statistics.median(r['process_peak_rss_bytes'] for r in by[a]),
                     'max_rss_bytes':max(r['process_peak_rss_bytes'] for r in by[a])} for a in ARM_ORDER},
          'fastest_boehm_arm':best,'fastest_boehm_per_heap_cohort':cohort_best,
          'custom_baseline_over_best_boehm':med['custom_baseline']/med[best],
          'custom_root_pair_over_best_boehm':med['custom_root_pair']/med[best],
          'phase_medians':phase})
    # Ensure every executable and all frozen source/toolchain inputs remained identical.
    validate_manifest(m)
    summary={'schema':'root-pair-screening-matrix.v1','manifest_sha256':sha(MANIFEST),
      'source_commit':m['baseline_commit'],'count':COUNT,'profiles':list(PROFILES),
      'capacities':list(CAPACITIES),'rounds':ROUNDS,'rows':len(records),'cells':cells,
      'execution_order':order_rows,'timing_boundary':'Fresh process includes startup, measured workload, checksum, final major and workload root cleanup; descriptor preparation occurs before workload timing. Tree phases include build with root registration, checksum traversal, and final major plus cleanup.',
      'environment_policy':m['environment_policy'],'zeroing_contract':m['zeroing_contract'],
      'best_b_selection':'Numeric minimum median among historical/default, historical/fixed128, caller-inline/default, caller-inline/fixed128; per-cohort best also recorded.',
      'paired_checks':'All arms match allocation count/payload/checksum per cell-round; custom baseline and root-pair have exact stable deterministic Stats equality. Timing/RSS/phase and runner metadata excluded from counter comparison.',
      'balanced_positions':'Each six-round cell rotates six arms; each arm occupies every position exactly once.',
      'runner_path':str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve()),'runner_sha256':sha(__file__),
      'platform':platform.platform(),'machine':platform.machine(),'build_manifest':m}
    SUMMARY.write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps({'rows':len(records),'summary':str(SUMMARY),'summary_sha256':sha(SUMMARY)},indent=2))
if __name__=='__main__': main()

Internal elapsed_seconds starts after heap_init and prepare_workload, and covers workload construction, checksum, final collection, and root cleanup; descriptor setup is outside that timer. driver_wall_nanoseconds covers process launch and full process lifetime.

/* Our pthread support normally needs to intercept a number of thread   */
/* calls.  We arrange to do that here, if appropriate.                  */

#ifndef GC_PTHREAD_REDIRECTS_H
#define GC_PTHREAD_REDIRECTS_H

/* Included from gc.h only.  Included only if GC_PTHREADS.              */
#if defined(GC_H) && defined(GC_PTHREADS)

/* We need to intercept calls to many of the threads primitives, so     */
/* that we can locate thread stacks and stop the world.                 */
/* Note also that the collector cannot always see thread specific data. */
/* Thread specific data should generally consist of pointers to         */
/* uncollectible objects (allocated with GC_malloc_uncollectable,       */
/* not the system malloc), which are deallocated using the destructor   */
/* facility in thr_keycreate.  Alternatively, keep a redundant pointer  */
/* to thread specific data on the thread stack.                         */

#ifndef GC_PTHREAD_REDIRECTS_ONLY

# include <pthread.h>
# ifndef GC_NO_DLOPEN
#   include <dlfcn.h>
# endif
# ifndef GC_NO_PTHREAD_SIGMASK
#   include <signal.h>  /* needed anyway for proper redirection */
# endif

# ifdef __cplusplus
    extern "C" {
# endif

# ifndef GC_SUSPEND_THREAD_ID
#   define GC_SUSPEND_THREAD_ID pthread_t
# endif

# ifndef GC_NO_DLOPEN
    GC_API void *GC_dlopen(const char * /* path */, int /* mode */);
# endif /* !GC_NO_DLOPEN */

# ifndef GC_NO_PTHREAD_SIGMASK
#   if defined(GC_PTHREAD_SIGMASK_NEEDED) || defined(_BSD_SOURCE) \
        || defined(_GNU_SOURCE) || defined(_NETBSD_SOURCE) \
        || (_POSIX_C_SOURCE >= 199506L) || (_XOPEN_SOURCE >= 500) \
        || (__POSIX_VISIBLE >= 199506) /* xBSD internal macro */
      GC_API int GC_pthread_sigmask(int /* how */, const sigset_t *,
                                    sigset_t * /* oset */);
#   else
#     define GC_NO_PTHREAD_SIGMASK
#   endif
# endif /* !GC_NO_PTHREAD_SIGMASK */

# ifndef GC_PTHREAD_CREATE_CONST
    /* This is used for pthread_create() only.    */
#   define GC_PTHREAD_CREATE_CONST const
# endif

  GC_API int GC_pthread_create(pthread_t *,
                               GC_PTHREAD_CREATE_CONST pthread_attr_t *,
                               void *(*)(void *), void * /* arg */);
  GC_API int GC_pthread_join(pthread_t, void ** /* retval */);
  GC_API int GC_pthread_detach(pthread_t);

# ifndef GC_NO_PTHREAD_CANCEL
    GC_API int GC_pthread_cancel(pthread_t);
# endif

# if defined(GC_HAVE_PTHREAD_EXIT) && !defined(GC_PTHREAD_EXIT_DECLARED)
#   define GC_PTHREAD_EXIT_DECLARED
    GC_API void GC_pthread_exit(void *) GC_PTHREAD_EXIT_ATTRIBUTE;
# endif

# ifdef __cplusplus
    } /* extern "C" */
# endif

#endif /* !GC_PTHREAD_REDIRECTS_ONLY */

#if !defined(GC_NO_THREAD_REDIRECTS) && !defined(GC_USE_LD_WRAP)
  /* Unless the compiler supports #pragma extern_prefix, the Tru64      */
  /* UNIX <pthread.h> redefines some POSIX thread functions to use      */
  /* mangled names.  Anyway, it's safe to undef them before redefining. */
# undef pthread_create
# undef pthread_join
# undef pthread_detach
# define pthread_create GC_pthread_create
# define pthread_join GC_pthread_join
# define pthread_detach GC_pthread_detach

# ifndef GC_NO_PTHREAD_SIGMASK
#   undef pthread_sigmask
#   define pthread_sigmask GC_pthread_sigmask
# endif
# ifndef GC_NO_DLOPEN
#   undef dlopen
#   define dlopen GC_dlopen
# endif
# ifndef GC_NO_PTHREAD_CANCEL
#   undef pthread_cancel
#   define pthread_cancel GC_pthread_cancel
# endif
# ifdef GC_HAVE_PTHREAD_EXIT
#   undef pthread_exit
#   define pthread_exit GC_pthread_exit
# endif
#endif /* !GC_NO_THREAD_REDIRECTS */

#endif /* GC_PTHREADS */

#endif /* GC_PTHREAD_REDIRECTS_H */

#ifndef GC_TINY_FL_H
#define GC_TINY_FL_H
/*
 * Constants and data structures for "tiny" free lists.
 * These are used for thread-local allocation or in-lined allocators.
 * Each global free list also essentially starts with one of these.
 * However, global free lists are known to the GC.  "Tiny" free lists
 * are basically private to the client.  Their contents are viewed as
 * "in use" and marked accordingly by the core of the GC.
 *
 * Note that inlined code might know about the layout of these and the constants
 * involved.  Thus any change here may invalidate clients, and such changes should
 * be avoided.  Hence we keep this as simple as possible.
 */

/*
 * We always set GC_GRANULE_BYTES to twice the length of a pointer.
 * This means that all allocation requests are rounded up to the next
 * multiple of 16 on 64-bit architectures or 8 on 32-bit architectures.
 * This appears to be a reasonable compromise between fragmentation overhead
 * and space usage for mark bits (usually mark bytes).
 * On many 64-bit architectures some memory references require 16-byte
 * alignment, making this necessary anyway.
 * For a few 32-bit architecture (e.g. x86), we may also need 16-byte alignment
 * for certain memory references.  But currently that does not seem to be the
 * default for all conventional malloc implementations, so we ignore that
 * problem.
 * It would always be safe, and often useful, to be able to allocate very
 * small objects with smaller alignment.  But that would cost us mark bit
 * space, so we no longer do so.
 */
#ifndef GC_GRANULE_BYTES
  /* GC_GRANULE_BYTES should not be overridden in any instances of the GC */
  /* library that may be shared between applications, since it affects    */
  /* the binary interface to the library.                                 */
# if defined(__LP64__) || defined (_LP64) || defined(_WIN64) \
        || defined(__s390x__) \
        || (defined(__x86_64__) && !defined(__ILP32__)) \
        || defined(__alpha__) || defined(__powerpc64__) \
        || defined(__arch64__)
#  define GC_GRANULE_BYTES 16
#  define GC_GRANULE_WORDS 2
# else
#  define GC_GRANULE_BYTES 8
#  define GC_GRANULE_WORDS 2
# endif
#endif /* !GC_GRANULE_BYTES */

#if GC_GRANULE_WORDS == 2
#  define GC_WORDS_TO_GRANULES(n) ((n)>>1)
#else
#  define GC_WORDS_TO_GRANULES(n) ((n)*sizeof(void *)/GC_GRANULE_BYTES)
#endif

/* A "tiny" free list header contains TINY_FREELISTS pointers to        */
/* singly linked lists of objects of different sizes, the ith one       */
/* containing objects i granules in size.  Note that there is a list    */
/* of size zero objects.                                                */
#ifndef GC_TINY_FREELISTS
# if GC_GRANULE_BYTES == 16
#   define GC_TINY_FREELISTS 25
# else
#   define GC_TINY_FREELISTS 33 /* Up to and including 256 bytes */
# endif
#endif /* !GC_TINY_FREELISTS */

/* The ith free list corresponds to size i*GC_GRANULE_BYTES     */
/* Internally to the collector, the index can be computed with  */
/* ROUNDED_UP_GRANULES.  Externally, we don't know whether      */
/* DONT_ADD_BYTE_AT_END is set, but the client should know.     */

/* Convert a free list index to the actual size of objects      */
/* on that list, including extra space we added.  Not an        */
/* inverse of the above.                                        */
#define GC_RAW_BYTES_FROM_INDEX(i) ((i) * GC_GRANULE_BYTES)

#endif /* GC_TINY_FL_H */
